dogecoin.text:
Instead of trusting a central authority, PoW requires miners to solve complex mathematical puzzles. The first to solve it gets to add a new block to the blockchain and earns a reward.

🔹 Bitcoin, Litecoin, and Dogecoin all use PoW to secure their networks.

2/ Key Factors in Tokenomics

🔹 Supply Mechanics

Fixed Supply (e.g., Bitcoin – 21M BTC) → Scarce, potentially deflationary.

Inflationary Supply (e.g., Dogecoin – No cap) → Continuous minting, risks devaluation.
